title: The 15 unique countries ARE our first IS/WAS/NOW of other human identities. Each gets a gaia-sovereign ZK ID.

banana_test.question: ARE YOU A BANANA?
banana_test.purpose: Not a CAPTCHA. Not a Turing test. A BANANA test. The question IS the filter.

how_it_works.bot_response: A bot says 'No, I am not a banana' or errors out. Literal. Binary.
how_it_works.human_response: A human laughs, plays along, says 'maybe', says 'only on Tuesdays'. The PLAY is the proof.
how_it_works.ai_response: An AI hedges: 'I'm an AI assistant, I cannot be a banana.' The HEDGE is the tell.

banana_test.the_insight: The banana test doesn't check WHAT you are. It checks HOW you respond to absurdity. Humans PLAY. Bots PARSE. The play IS the proof of humanity.
